# สล็อตเว็บตรง
* [ dev_aspjj ][10]
* [ เมษายน 14, 2023 ][11]
* 11:40 am

**สารบัญ** [ซ่อน][12]
[ 1 สล็อตเว็บตรง เว็บสล็อตติดอันดับ 1 เล่นง่าย แตกบ่อย รองรับการเล่นด้วยระบบ Auto ][13]
[ 1.1 สล็อตเว็บตรง คืออะไร เล่นด้วยระบบออโต้เสียเงินเพิ่มไหม ? ][14]
[ 1.2 เริ่มต้นสมัครใช้งาน สล็อตเว็บตรง เล่นได้ทั้งวัน ไม่ล็อคเงินรางวัลจากการเล่น เบทได้ไม่มีขั้นต่ำ ][15]
[ 1.3 ทำไมถึงต้องเลือกเล่น สล็อตเว็บตรง เล่นที่นี่ แตกต่างจากเว็บอื่นอย่างไร ? ][16]
[ 1.4 ระบบการเล่นทันสมัย สล็อตเว็บตรง อัตราชนะสูงด้วยค่า RTP ที่ดีที่สุดในไทย ][17]
[ 1.5 ลงทะเบียนเล่นเกม สล็อตเว็บตรง สดใหม่ ฝาก-ถอนปลอดภัยได้เงินชัวร์ ][18]
[ 1.6 ข้อดีของการเล่น สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่หลายคนอาจไม่เคยรู้มาก่อน ][19]
[ 1.6.1 เปิดให้บริการตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง ][20]
[ 1.6.2 เล่นได้ทุกแพลตฟอร์ม รองรับการเล่นบนมือถือ ][21]
[ 1.6.3 สมัครสมาชิกได้แบบฟรีๆ ][22]
[ 1.6.4 เริ่มต้นเบทสล็อตไม่มีขั้นต่ำ ][23]
[ 1.7 แตกหนักโบนัสสูง สล็อตเว็บตรง ไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ เล่นง่ายในงบราคาประหยัด ][24]
[ 1.8 เกมสล็อตยอดนิยม 6 รูปแบบจาก สล็อตเว็บตรง การันตีเล่นง่าย ตัวคูณรางวัล และอัตราจ่ายสูง ][25]
[ 1.8.1 Zombie Outbreak ][26]
[ 1.8.2 Werewolf's Hunt ][27]
[ 1.8.3 Lucky Clover Lady ][28]
[ 1.8.4 Totem Wonders ][29]
[ 1.8.5 Mystic Potion ][30]
[ 1.8.6 Super Golf Drive ][31]
[ 1.9 สล็อตเว็บตรง โปรโมชั่นให้เลือกเยอะ ไม่ต้องทำเทิร์นมีให้เลือกเพียบ ][32]
[ 1.10 แนะนำเว็บชั้นนำด้าน สล็อตเว็บตรง ปั่นสล็อตสนุกแตกหนักด้วยค่า RTP ที่สูงกว่าที่อื่น ][33]
[ 1.10.1 K9WIN ][34]
[ 1.10.2 1XBET ][35]
[ 1.10.3 FUN88 ][36]
[ 1.10.4 FAFA666 ][37]
[ 1.10.5 FAFA178 ][38]
[ 1.10.6 FAFA123 ][39]
[ 1.11 สล็อตเว็บตรง มีวิธีการเล่นให้ได้เงินสูงสุด เริ่มด้วยเบท 1 บาทเท่านั้น ][40]
[ 1.12 เพิ่มเกมใหม่อัตราแตกสูง สล็อตเว็บตรง ให้บริการไม่มีขั้นต่ำได้เงินเต็มจำนวน ][41]
[ 1.13 สล็อตเว็บตรง จัดหนัก จัดเต็มด้วยเงินรางวัลมูลค่ามากกว่าหลักล้าน ][42]
[ 1.14 เทคนิคการทำเงิน สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่มีความแม่นยำสูง เหมาะกับผู้เล่นสายปั่นสล็อต ][43]
[ 1.15 เว็บสล็อตชั้นนำอันดับ 1 สล็อตเว็บตรง สมัครสมาชิกฟรีค่าธรรมเนียม 1 บัญชีเล่นได้ครบทุกเกม ][44]
[ 1.16 FAQs คำถามที่พบบ่อย ][45]
[ 1.16.1 สล็อตเว็บตรง ระบบฝาก - ถอนได้เงินจริงไหม? ][46]
[ 1.16.2 โปรโมชั่นของ สล็อตเว็บตรง มีอะไรบ้าง ? ][47]
[ 1.16.3 เข้ามาสมัครสมาชิก สล็อตเว็บตรง มีการคิดเงินหรือไม่ ? ][48]
[ 1.17 ร่วมสนุกสุดมันส์ไปกับ สล็อตเว็บตรง อัปเดตเกมฮิต เล่นเกมสดใหม่ไม่ต้องทำเทิร์น ][49]

การันตีแจ๊คพอตแตกบ่อยแน่นอน แถมเกม สล็อต ทุกเกมบนเว็บไซต์ของเรา ยังมีรูปแบบการเล่นที่ไม่ซับซ้อน
แถมยังรองรับการเล่นด้วยระบบออโต้ ถึงแม้ว่าจะเป็นนักพนันมือใหม่หัดเล่น ก็สามารถเข้ามาสร้างกำไรบนเว็บไซต์ของเราได้อย่างง่ายๆ
ซึ่งเป็นเว็บไซต์ สล็อตออนไลน์ ที่มีบริการสุดล้ำสมัย และมีบริการครบวงจรมากที่สุดเลยทีเดียว

พร้อมการันตีแต่โบนัสสูงที่สุดแน่นอน ผู้ให้บริการ สล็อตเว็บตรง ไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ของเรา เล่นง่ายในงบราคาประหยัด
ดังนั้นแล้วนักพนันก็ห้ามพลาดที่จะได้เข้ามาใช้บริการบนเว็บไซต์ที่นี่กันโดยเด็ดขาด หากเข้ามาปั่นสล็อตบนเว็บไซต์ของเราแล้ว
ทุกท่านก็จะได้พบกับความเพลิดเพลินในการเดิมพันได้อย่างเต็มที่ และมีสิทธิ์ประสบความสำเร็จในการสร้างกำไรได้ตลอดทุกวันเลยทีเดียว

## เกมสล็อตยอดนิยม 6 รูปแบบจาก สล็อตเว็บตรง การันตีเล่นง่าย ตัวคูณรางวัล และอัตราจ่ายสูง

เปิดลิสต์รายชื่อ 6 รูปแบบเกมสล็อตยอดนิยมจาก สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่การันตีว่าเล่นง่าย ตัวคูณรางวัลเยอะ พร้อมอัตราการจ่ายที่สูง
บอกเลยว่าเป็นเกม 6 สไตล์ที่มาพร้อมกับรูปแบบการเล่นที่น่าสนใจ และเป็นเกมที่ทำกำไรได้ดีที่สุด
รับประกันได้เลยว่าเป็นเกมที่สามารถสร้างกำไรให้กับสายปั่นทุกท่านได้อย่างล้นหลามแน่นอน
ซึ่งวันนี้เราจะมานำเสนอเกี่ยวกับจุดเด่นของแต่ละเกม ที่ทุกท่านสามารถเลือกเล่นได้อย่างเต็มที่

## สล็อตเว็บตรง คืออะไร เล่นด้วยระบบออโต้เสียเงินเพิ่มไหม ?

เข้ามาเล่นเกมสล็อตบน สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่นี่ด้วยระบบ Auto ไม่เสียเงินเพิ่มแน่นอน แถมทุกท่านยังจะได้สร้างประสบการณ์ใหม่ๆ
สำหรับการเล่นเกม สล็อต บนเว็บไซต์ของเราได้อย่างเต็มที่อีกด้วย ดังนั้นแล้วนักพนันท่านใดที่ชื่นชอบการเข้าเล่นเกมสล็อต
ก็อย่าได้พลาดโอกาสดีๆ ที่จะได้เข้ามาสร้างกำไรบนเว็บไซต์แห่งนี้กันโดยเด็ดขาด รับรองได้เลยว่าหากเข้ามาใช้บริการบน เว็บตรงสล็อต
ของเราแล้ว นักพนันทุกท่านจะต้องติดใจกันอย่างแน่นอน

## เริ่มต้นสมัครใช้งาน สล็อตเว็บตรง เล่นได้ทั้งวัน ไม่ล็อคเงินรางวัลจากการเล่น เบทได้ไม่มีขั้นต่ำ

เริ่มต้นสมัครเข้าใช้งาน สล็อตเว็บตรง บนเว็บไซต์ที่นี่ ก็สามารถเข้าเล่นได้ตลอดทั้งวัน แถมทาง เว็บสล็อตใหม่ล่าสุด
เรายังไม่มีการล็อคเงินรางวัลจากการเข้าเล่น ซึ่งสามารถเข้าเดิมพันได้อย่างสบายใจ
แถมทางเรายังเปิดให้เริ่มต้นเดิมพันสล็อตได้แบบไม่มีขั้นต่ำ บอกเลยว่า 1 บาทก็สามารถเข้าเดิมพันได้อย่างเต็มที่
เพราะแบบนี้เว็บไซต์ของเราจึงได้รับความสนใจ และมีนักพนัน สมัครเว็บสล็อต เข้ามาใช้บริการกันอย่างไม่ขาดสาย

## ทำไมถึงต้องเลือกเล่น สล็อตเว็บตรง เล่นที่นี่ แตกต่างจากเว็บอื่นอย่างไร ?

เหตุผลที่สายป่านจะต้องเข้ามาเล่น สล็อตเว็บตรง กับเว็บไซต์ที่นี่ เว็บไซต์ของเราขึ้นชื่อว่าเป็นเว็บที่ทำเงินได้ดีที่สุด
แถมเว็บไซต์ของเรายังให้อัตราการจ่ายเงินรางวัลที่สูงมากๆ เพียงนำเงินเข้ามาลงทุนบนเว็บไซต์ สล็อตเว็บตรง ฝาก-ถอน true
wallet ไม่มี ขั้น ต่ํา ของเรา ทุกท่านก็สามารถลุ้นรับกำไรได้อย่างจัดเต็ม และจะได้เปิดประสบการณ์ใหม่ๆ
ในการเข้าเล่นเกมสล็อตได้ก่อนใครแน่นอน
* เล่นง่ายได้เงินทันที

เกมสล็อตทุกเกมบน เว็บสล็อต ของเรา เป็นเกมที่เล่นง่ายมากๆ หากชนะเดิมพันในการเล่นเกมสล็อตบนเว็บไซต์ของเรา
ทุกท่านก็สามารถผลกำไรออกไปได้ทันที โดยที่ไม่เสียค่าธรรมเนียมเลยแม้แต่บาทเดียวแน่นอน ไม่ว่าจะเป็นยอดเงินที่สูงมากแค่ไหน
ก็สามารถถอนกำไรออกจากเว็บไซต์ สล็อตเว็บตรง อันดับ 1 ของเราได้ทุกบาททุกสตางค์ 
* ทุกเกมสล็อตไม่ต้องทำเทิร์น

ทุกเกมสล็อตบน เว็บสล็อต อันดับ 1 ของเรา สามารถเข้าเล่นโดยที่ไม่ต้องทำเทิร์น เป็นเว็บไซต์ที่มีบริการที่ดีมากๆ
แถมยังมีขั้นตอนการถอนเงินที่ไม่ยุ่งยาก ไม่ว่าจะเป็นยอดเงินหลักแสนหรือหลักล้าน
เว็บไซต์ของเราก็สามารถจ่ายเงินรางวัลได้แบบไม่ขาดตกบกพร่อง บอกเลยว่าเป็นเว็บไซต์ สล็อตเว็บตรงแตกหนัก
ที่ตอบสนองความต้องการ ให้กับนักพนันทุกท่านได้เป็นอย่างดีทุกรอบด้าน 
* ฝาก-ถอนด้วยระบบอัตโนมัติ

แน่นอนว่าเว็บไซต์ สล็อตเว็บตรง ของเรามีระบบการฝากถอนแบบอัตโนมัติ ซึ่งสามารถทำรายการฝากถอนในแต่ละครั้งโดยใช้เวลาไม่ถึง

ไม่เพียงเท่านี้ทางเรายังรองรับการฝากถอนผ่าน True wallet ไม่มีขั้นต่ำ ไม่มีบัญชีธนาคาร ก็เข้าใช้งานเว็บไซต์

## ระบบการเล่นทันสมัย สล็อตเว็บตรง อัตราชนะสูงด้วยค่า RTP ที่ดีที่สุดในไทย

ในปัจจุบันนี้เว็บไซต์ของเรา มาพร้อมกับระบบการเล่นที่ทันสมัย แถมยังมีเกม สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่มาพร้อมกับค่า RTP ที่ดีที่สุดในไทย
เพียงเข้ามาร่วมลงทุนบน เว็บสล็อตใหม่ล่าสุด ของเรา รับประกันได้เลยว่าสามารถรับทรัพย์ได้อย่างเน้นๆ
ซึ่งสามารถสร้างกำไรได้สูงถึงหลักล้านแน่นอน ดังนั้นแล้วนักพนันทุกท่าน ก็อย่าได้พลาดโอกาสดีๆ ที่จะได้เข้ามาร่วมลงทุนบนเว็บไซต์

## ลงทะเบียนเล่นเกม สล็อตเว็บตรง สดใหม่ ฝาก-ถอนปลอดภัยได้เงินชัวร์

ทุกท่านสามารถลงทะเบียนเข้ามาเล่นเกม สล็อตเว็บตรง บนเว็บไซต์ของเราได้แบบสดใหม่ตลอดทุกวัน แถมทาง เว็บสล็อตออนไลน์
ที่ดีที่สุด ของเรายังมาพร้อมกับระบบความปลอดภัยที่สูง ซึ่งสามารถทำรายการฝากถอนเงินได้อย่างสบายใจ
และเว็บไซต์ของเรายังเป็นผู้ให้บริการเกมสล็อตเว็บตรงไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ ดังนั้นแล้วจึงเป็นช่องทางการเข้าเล่นเกม สล็อตเว็บตรง
ฝาก-ถอน true wallet ไม่มี ธนาคาร ไม่มี ขั้น ต่ํา ที่สายปั่นทุกท่านสามารถเชื่อถือได้อย่างแน่นอน

## ข้อดีของการเล่น สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่หลายคนอาจไม่เคยรู้มาก่อน

วันนี้เราจะมาเปิดข้อดีของการเข้าเล่น สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่นักพนันหลายท่านอาจจะยังไม่เคยรู้มาก่อน
เว็บไซต์ของเราได้รับกระแสมาแรงมากๆ ซึ่งเป็นช่องทางเข้าเล่นเกม สล็อตเว็บตรง แตกง่าย
ที่มีนักพนันเข้าใช้บริการกันอย่างไม่ขาดสาย แถมเว็บไซต์ของเรายังมาพร้อมกับบริการชั้นเยี่ยม รับรองได้เลยว่าทุกท่านจะต้องประทับใจ
ตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกที่เข้ามาใช้บริการบนเว็บไซต์ สล็อต เว็บตรงไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ไม่มีขั้นต่ำ ของเรากันอย่างแน่นอน

### เปิดให้บริการตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง

เว็บไซต์ สล็อตเว็บตรง ไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ ของเราเปิดให้บริการตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง ไม่มีวันปิดทำการ ดังนั้นแล้วไม่ว่าจะอยู่ที่ไหน
และไม่ว่าจะเป็นช่วงเวลาไหน ก็สามารถเข้ามาสร้างกำไรบนเว็บไซต์ของเราได้ตลอดทุกเวลา บอกเลยว่าเป็นเว็บไซต์ ปั่นสล็อต
ที่สามารถ login เข้าใช้งานได้อย่างสะดวกสบาย และเข้าเล่นได้อย่างปลอดภัยแน่นอน

### เล่นได้ทุกแพลตฟอร์ม รองรับการเล่นบนมือถือ

ทางเราเปิดให้รับพนันทุกท่าน เข้ามาเล่นเกม สล็อตออนไลน์ ได้เงินจริง บนเว็บไซต์ของเรา ได้ทุกแพลตฟอร์มการใช้งาน
แถมยังสามารถรองรับการเล่นผ่านมือถือได้ทุกระบบ ไม่ว่าจะใช้มือถือระบบ Android หรือระบบ iOS ก็ตาม
ก็สามารถเข้ามาเล่นเกมสล็อตบนเว็บไซต์ของเราได้อย่างเต็มที่ พร้อมการันตีสามารถเข้าเล่นได้อย่างไหลลื่น ไม่มีสะดุด

### สมัครสมาชิกได้แบบฟรีๆ

ทางเรายังเปิดให้นักพนันทุกท่านสมัครเข้ามาใช้บริการได้แบบฟรีๆ โดยที่ไม่เสียค่าธรรมเนียมเลยแม้แต่บาทเดียวแน่นอน
ซึ่งทุกท่านสามารถสมัครเข้ามาใช้งานบนเว็บไซต์ สล็อตเว็บตรงวอเลท ของเราได้ง่ายมากๆ โดยใช้เวลาไม่ถึง 1 นาทีอีกด้วย
หากเข้ามาใช้บริการบนเว็บไซต์ของเราแล้ว ก็สามารถเลือกรับสิทธิพิเศษได้อย่างจุใจ

### เริ่มต้นเบทสล็อตไม่มีขั้นต่ำ

เว็บไซต์ของเรายังเปิดให้เริ่มต้นเล่นสล็อตได้แบบไม่มีขั้นต่ำ ดังนั้นแล้ว 1 บาทก็สามารถเข้าเล่นได้ทุกค่ายเกมแบรนด์ดัง
รับประกันได้เลยว่าจะต้องเป็นช่องทางการเข้าเล่นสล็อต ที่นักพนันทุนน้อยจะต้องชื่นชอบกันอย่างแน่นอน
มีทั้งเว็บไซต์ของเรายังให้อัตราการจ่ายเงินรางวัลที่สูงที่สุดในไทย ถึงแม้ว่าจะลงทุนน้อย ก็สามารถสร้างกำไรได้สูงชัวร์

## แตกหนักโบนัสสูง สล็อตเว็บตรง ไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ เล่นง่ายในงบราคาประหยัด

พร้อมการันตีแต่โบนัสสูงที่สุดแน่นอน ผู้ให้บริการ สล็อตเว็บตรง ไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ของเรา เล่นง่ายในงบราคาประหยัด
ดังนั้นแล้วนักพนันก็ห้ามพลาดที่จะได้เข้ามาใช้บริการบนเว็บไซต์ที่นี่กันโดยเด็ดขาด หากเข้ามาปั่นสล็อตบนเว็บไซต์ของเราแล้ว
ทุกท่านก็จะได้พบกับความเพลิดเพลินในการเดิมพันได้อย่างเต็มที่ และมีสิทธิ์ประสบความสำเร็จในการสร้างกำไรได้ตลอดทุกวันเลยทีเดียว

## เกมสล็อตยอดนิยม 6 รูปแบบจาก สล็อตเว็บตรง การันตีเล่นง่าย ตัวคูณรางวัล และอัตราจ่ายสูง

เปิดลิสต์รายชื่อ 6 รูปแบบเกมสล็อตยอดนิยมจาก สล็อตเว็บตรง ที่การันตีว่าเล่นง่าย ตัวคูณรางวัลเยอะ พร้อมอัตราการจ่ายที่สูง
บอกเลยว่าเป็นเกม 6 สไตล์ที่มาพร้อมกับรูปแบบการเล่นที่น่าสนใจ และเป็นเกมที่ทำกำไรได้ดีที่สุด
รับประกันได้เลยว่าเป็นเกมที่สามารถสร้างกำไรให้กับสายปั่นทุกท่านได้อย่างล้นหลามแน่นอน
ซึ่งวันนี้เราจะมานำเสนอเกี่ยวกับจุดเด่นของแต่ละเกม ที่ทุกท่านสามารถเลือกเล่นได้อย่างเต็มที่

Water is at the heart of AI. You need water to produce chips, to power them, and to cool them. There

People Health

Planet Health

Business Health

# Reliable Diagnostic Solutions for Hygiene and Food Safety Testing

Hygiena provides fast detection, identification, and monitoring solutions for contaminants like
microorganisms, allergens, and mycotoxins, as well as tests for GMOs and animal species. We serve
industries such as food and beverage and healthcare to ensure safety and quality.

## We Create Innovative Diagnostics for a Healthier World

At Hygiena, we provide first-class testing solutions for diverse industries, including food and
beverage, healthcare, hospitality, pharmaceuticals, and personal care. Leveraging advanced
technologies and patented designs, our industry-leading ATP monitoring systems, real-time PCR-based
foodborne pathogen and spoilage organism detection, animal identification, GMO screening, allergen,
and ELISA-based mycotoxin tests ensure precise and reliable results. With a commitment to
innovation, we empower businesses to meet the highest safety and quality standards, creating a
healthier world.

## One Health Diagnostics^{®}: Hygiena's Commitment to Safe and Sustainable Food

Our journey from farm to table emphasizes the importance of safety, sustainability, and health in
transforming the global food supply chain. With proven solutions like ATP monitoring, real-time PCR
and ELISA tests, Hygiena ensures early disease detection in livestock and prevents food
contamination at every step, from production to retail. The company's holistic 'One Health
Diagnostics' approach ties the health of people to animals and the environment, leveraging
sophisticated data management like the SureTrend® digital platform to uphold the highest standards
of food safety and sustainability.

# Reliable Diagnostic Solutions for Hygiene and Food Safety Testing

Hygiena provides fast detection, identification, and monitoring solutions for contaminants like
microorganisms, allergens, and mycotoxins, as well as tests for GMOs and animal species. We serve
industries such as food and beverage and healthcare to ensure safety and quality.

[Pick Your Industry
[arrow-down][arrow-down]

[Talk to an expert][204]

[Go to next]

## We Create Innovative Diagnostics for a Healthier World

At Hygiena, we provide first-class testing solutions for diverse industries, including food and
beverage, healthcare, hospitality, pharmaceuticals, and personal care. Leveraging advanced
technologies and patented designs, our industry-leading ATP monitoring systems, real-time PCR-based
foodborne pathogen and spoilage organism detection, animal identification, GMO screening, allergen,
and ELISA-based mycotoxin tests ensure precise and reliable results. With a commitment to
innovation, we empower businesses to meet the highest safety and quality standards, creating a
healthier world.

## One Health Diagnostics^{®}: Hygiena's Commitment to Safe and Sustainable Food

Our journey from farm to table emphasizes the importance of safety, sustainability, and health in
transforming the global food supply chain. With proven solutions like ATP monitoring, real-time PCR
and ELISA tests, Hygiena ensures early disease detection in livestock and prevents food
contamination at every step, from production to retail. The company's holistic 'One Health
Diagnostics' approach ties the health of people to animals and the environment, leveraging
sophisticated data management like the SureTrend® digital platform to uphold the highest standards
of food safety and sustainability.

# Endoscopy Products for Gastroenterology Procedures & Endoscope Reprocessing

STERIS helps Customers advance patient care throughout every step of the gastrointestinal (GI)
procedure and endoscope reprocessing process. Our comprehensive procedural endoscopy products,
therapeutic devices, and endoscope reprocessing products and equipment help support Endoscopy Suites
in both hospitals and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs).

Find endoscopy products and instruments to help support GI procedures in your facility.

To view device compatibility for Medivators Automated Endoscope Reprocessors (previously available
in the Medivators HULU tool), including required hookup connectors and parameter sets, please visit
the STERIS [Device Matrix][156].

# Endoscopy Products for Gastroenterology Procedures & Endoscope Reprocessing

STERIS helps Customers advance patient care throughout every step of the gastrointestinal (GI)
procedure and endoscope reprocessing process. Our comprehensive procedural endoscopy products,
therapeutic devices, and endoscope reprocessing products and equipment help support Endoscopy Suites
in both hospitals and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs).

Find endoscopy products and instruments to help support GI procedures in your facility.

To view device compatibility for Medivators Automated Endoscope Reprocessors (previously available
in the Medivators HULU tool), including required hookup connectors and parameter sets, please visit
the STERIS [Device Matrix][156].

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## BFR systems® detected

The system for detection of biological films formed by gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria on
abiotic surfaces. The system consists of three express tests to detect and destroy biostructures
such as substances of bacteria biological film.

## BFR fluorofilm

A fluorochrome-based indicator that selectively bonds to lipopolysaccharides of biofilm matrix
exopolysaccharides.

Transmitted green fluorescence is used for visualization. Eye protection is required.

## BFR peroxyfilm

Indicator for detection of bacterial contamination and biofilms on different abiotic surfaces.

Bacterial detection is based on barbotage or micro-bubbles that appear on a treated surface as a
result of catalase produced by bacteria in the presence of hydrogen peroxide.

Naked-eye detection of reaction.

## BFR enzymofilm

The indicator is based on multi-enzyme preparation ‘ENZYMIX’.

A combination of enzymes belonging to a group of  carbohydrases destructs with proven effectiveness 
exopolysaccharides of biofilm matrix facilitating access to bacteria. It allows making
microbiological washouts to determine microbial contamination of various surfaces with high
reliability.

## BFR peroxyfilm Food

Biofilm indicator for various abiotic surfaces in the food and processing industries.

BFR peroxyfilm Food indicator is a ready-to-use product available as blue gel-like liquid.

## Disinfecting agents effective on biological films

Special disinfectants have a combined effect – they destruct biofilm matrix exopolysaccharides,
effectively penetrate through biofilm barriers and exterminate bacteria that are enclosed within the
biofilm. They are also effective for pathogenic and mold fungi, M. tuberculosis, viruses, and
bacterial spores.

### BFR Activ

Granulated powder
Highly effective multi-purpose product with a wide spectrum of action for cleaning and disinfecting
surfaces, and equipment; high-level disinfection and sterilization of endoscopes and medical
instruments, air and medical waste sanitizing.

Surface disinfection – 5 minutes
Endoscopes high-level disinfection (HLD) – 5 minutes
Endoscopes and medical instruments sterilization – 30 minutes

**Ingredients: **
• ENZYMIX multi-enzyme preparation
• Sodium percarbonate

**Active agents: **
• Peracetic acid
• Carbohydrases

 

### BFR Biocid Enzym

Liquid concentrate
A multi-purpose disinfectant: surface cleaning, endoscopes, and instruments disinfection, air and
medical waste sanitizing.

**Ingredients:
**• ENZYMIX multi-enzyme preparation
• Tertiary alkylamines
• Mixtures of quaternary ammonium compounds (QAC)

### BFR Enzym Conc

Liquid concentrate
Disinfectant for manual and mechanical cleaning of surfaces, equipment, and instruments.

#### Anti-adhesion long-lasting effect

**Use:
**• Highly effective cleaning of abiotic surfaces
• Complex processing to combat biofilms
• Prevention of biofilm formation

**Ingredients:
**• ENZYMIX multi-enzyme preparation
• Nonionic surfactants
• Tensides

## Your custom pump solution

Follow the steps below and help us develop a pump that delivers the performance you need.

[ Discover more ][104]
* Understand your requirements
  
  We start with a full definition of your requirements beginning with your specifications.
* Close collaboration between engineering teams
  
  Our engineering team will review your requirements and start the dialog to clarify performance
  requirements. We contact your team, share technical information and CAD models, and establish
  project goals and timelines.
* Prototype within days
  
  Diener have a dedicated prototype shop where we can create or modify designs to fit your needs. We
  understand the need to stay on schedule, so our goal is to provide prototype sample pumps within
  days of receiving your inquiry.
* Refine and optimize for production
  
  The validation/verification step ensures we’ve met your requirements. A complete review of
  manufacturing processes ensures that we can consistently provide the highest quality product
  within your budget limits.

## Commercial and Industrial Pumps Applications

Discover our portfolio of precise, high-performance and robust dosing pumps and gear pumps for your
individual area of application.

[Right Arrow] [Right Arrow]
* [ [Medical Diagnostics and Analysis] ][105]
  
  #### [Laboratory and Clinical Diagnostics Pumps ][106]
  
  Diagnostic and Medical equipment covers a wide range of products and Diener Precision Pumps are
  ideal for all of them. Our gear pumps are typically used for waste and bulk fluid transfer
  applications, whereas our metering/dosing pumps are used where ultra-low (micro-dosing) is
  required.
  
  [ Discover more ][107]
* [ [DPP Cooling System 1200-500] ][108]
  
  #### [Cooling Systems Pumps ][109]
  
  Diener Precision gear pumps are the ideal choice for cooling systems, whether they be water,
  water/glycol, di-electric, or freon-based.
  
  [ Discover more ][110]
* [ [DPP Disinfection Precision Pumps] ][111]
  
  #### [Disinfection and Sterilization Systems Pumps ][112]
  
  Diener pumps are the go-to solution for sterilization systems, whether they be for surgical
  equipment cleaning or disinfection spray systems to combat the spread of the Covid-19 virus.
  
  [ Discover more ][113]
* [ [DPP video Thumbnail homepage ink] ][114]
  
  #### [Continuous Inkjet Printing Pumps ][115]
  
  Pulse-free pressure delivery, able to pump all types of dye and solvent-based inks,
  magnetically-coupled drives, precision performance electronic control; these are the features that
  make Diener Precision Pumps the preferred choice in continuous inkjet printers.
  
  [ Discover more ][116]
* [ [Gear pumps for beverage transfer & dispensing] ][117]
  
  #### [Food and Beverage Pumps ][118]
  
  Diener Precision Pumps complete line of “flow-thru” design pumps are ideal for beverage transfer
  and dispensing. This feature allows very quick clean-in-place flexibility and is certified to the
  National Sanitary Foundation (NSF/ANSI 169).
  
  [ Discover more ][119]
* [ [DPP Hemodialysis Metering Pumps trusted by Medical Experts] ][120]
  
  #### [Hemodialysis Pumps ][121]
  
  Repeatable pump-to-pump performance and micro-dosing is achieved via extremely small manufacturing
  tolerances, making for a better dialysis treatment and an enhanced patient experience.
  
  [ Discover more ][122]

## Commitment to Quality

At DPP, quality is more than just a word, quality is our conviction, our philosophy and what we
achieve every day. From product development in Lodi, California, to production in Embrach,
Switzerland and to providing support to our customers, there is only one standard we live by, to
offer the very best.
* All raw materials can be traced back 100 percent by batch to their origins.
* All products are tested 100 percent prior to shipping.
* To ensure high quality, we continuously invest in training, equipment, and R&D.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ See all FAQs ][124]
* What is the typical prototype price and lead time?
  
  We perform all prototype design/construction from our California [R&D facility][125]. Prototype
  design/fabrication range from 2-15 days. Prices vary depending on complexity.
* Is a custom pump more expensive than an off-the-shelf pump?
  
  Custom is sometimes misinterpreted to mean expensive. This is not the case. Designing a pump for a
  specific application ensures optimum performance, a small package size, minimum power consumption
  and long life—resulting in space savings, low power consumption and a lower installed cost.
* What does DPP provide?
  
  DPP designs and manufactures **custom pumps** to fulfill your OEM equipment requirements.
* What kind of testing does DPP offer?
  
  DPP tests at your operating conditions. This ensures that the pump performs to expectation before
  you validate in your equipment. We are also capable of conducting long-term endurance testing,
  environmental and chemical compatibility testing.
* Does DPP provide off-the-shelf pumps in small quantities?
  
  No. Every pump is designed and tailored to our customer’s exact needs. We have a minimum volume
  requirement of 100 pieces/y

## Your custom pump solution

Follow the steps below and help us develop a pump that delivers the performance you need.

[ Discover more ][104]
* Understand your requirements
  
  We start with a full definition of your requirements beginning with your specifications.
* Close collaboration between engineering teams
  
  Our engineering team will review your requirements and start the dialog to clarify performance
  requirements. We contact your team, share technical information and CAD models, and establish
  project goals and timelines.
* Prototype within days
  
  Diener have a dedicated prototype shop where we can create or modify designs to fit your needs. We
  understand the need to stay on schedule, so our goal is to provide prototype sample pumps within
  days of receiving your inquiry.
* Refine and optimize for production
  
  The validation/verification step ensures we’ve met your requirements. A complete review of
  manufacturing processes ensures that we can consistently provide the highest quality product
  within your budget limits.

## Commercial and Industrial Pumps Applications

Discover our portfolio of precise, high-performance and robust dosing pumps and gear pumps for your
individual area of application.

[Right Arrow] [Right Arrow]
* [ [Medical Diagnostics and Analysis] ][105]
  
  #### [Laboratory and Clinical Diagnostics Pumps ][106]
  
  Diagnostic and Medical equipment covers a wide range of products and Diener Precision Pumps are
  ideal for all of them. Our gear pumps are typically used for waste and bulk fluid transfer
  applications, whereas our metering/dosing pumps are used where ultra-low (micro-dosing) is
  required.
  
  [ Discover more ][107]
* [ [DPP Cooling System 1200-500] ][108]
  
  #### [Cooling Systems Pumps ][109]
  
  Diener Precision gear pumps are the ideal choice for cooling systems, whether they be water,
  water/glycol, di-electric, or freon-based.
  
  [ Discover more ][110]
* [ [DPP Disinfection Precision Pumps] ][111]
  
  #### [Disinfection and Sterilization Systems Pumps ][112]
  
  Diener pumps are the go-to solution for sterilization systems, whether they be for surgical
  equipment cleaning or disinfection spray systems to combat the spread of the Covid-19 virus.
  
  [ Discover more ][113]
* [ [DPP video Thumbnail homepage ink] ][114]
  
  #### [Continuous Inkjet Printing Pumps ][115]
  
  Pulse-free pressure delivery, able to pump all types of dye and solvent-based inks,
  magnetically-coupled drives, precision performance electronic control; these are the features that
  make Diener Precision Pumps the preferred choice in continuous inkjet printers.
  
  [ Discover more ][116]
* [ [Gear pumps for beverage transfer & dispensing] ][117]
  
  #### [Food and Beverage Pumps ][118]
  
  Diener Precision Pumps complete line of “flow-thru” design pumps are ideal for beverage transfer
  and dispensing. This feature allows very quick clean-in-place flexibility and is certified to the
  National Sanitary Foundation (NSF/ANSI 169).
  
  [ Discover more ][119]
* [ [DPP Hemodialysis Metering Pumps trusted by Medical Experts] ][120]
  
  #### [Hemodialysis Pumps ][121]
  
  Repeatable pump-to-pump performance and micro-dosing is achieved via extremely small manufacturing
  tolerances, making for a better dialysis treatment and an enhanced patient experience.
  
  [ Discover more ][122]
[Right Arrow] [Right Arrow]

## Commitment to Quality

At DPP, quality is more than just a word, quality is our conviction, our philosophy and what we
achieve every day. From product development in Lodi, California, to production in Embrach,
Switzerland and to providing support to our customers, there is only one standard we live by, to
offer the very best.
* All raw materials can be traced back 100 percent by batch to their origins.
* All products are tested 100 percent prior to shipping.
* To ensure high quality, we continuously invest in training, equipment, and R&D.

[Discover more][123]
[DDP Precision Gear Pump]

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ See all FAQs ][124]
* What is the typical prototype price and lead time?
  
  We perform all prototype design/construction from our California [R&D facility][125]. Prototype
  design/fabrication range from 2-15 days. Prices vary depending on complexity.
* Is a custom pump more expensive than an off-the-shelf pump?
  
  Custom is sometimes misinterpreted to mean expensive. This is not the case. Designing a pump for a
  specific application ensures optimum performance, a small package size, minimum power consumption
  and long life—resulting in space savings, low power consumption and a lower installed cost.
* What does DPP provide?
  
  DPP designs and manufactures **custom pumps** to fulfill your OEM equipment requirements.
* What kind of testing does DPP offer?
  
  DPP tests at your operating conditions. This ensures that the pump performs to expectation before
  you validate in your equipment. We are also capable of conducting long-term endurance testing,
  environmental and chemical compatibility testing.
* Does DPP provide off-the-shelf pumps in small quantities?
  
  No. Every pump is designed and tailored to our customer’s exact needs. We have a minimum volume
  requirement of 100 pieces/y

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[Guarda tutti i video][115]

### **Collegati ai tuoi sistemi EMEC
### da remoto con la nuova app myEmec**

Ovunque tua sia, potrai accedere direttamente dal tuo telefono a tutti i tuoi impianti in un’unica
app, in modo rapido e smart.

**Funzioni:**
*  Notifiche in tempo reale su status, allarmi e allerte
* Visualizza tutti i dati e modifica le impostazioni e le modalità di lavoro
* Registra nuovi controller e pompe sul tuo account
* Gestione multiutente semplice e veloce
* Accesso rapido alla documentazione tecnica
* Video tutorial su tutte le principali funzioni

[[Image link][Image link]][116]
[[Image link][Image link]][117]

### Le migliori soluzioni per il tuo settore

I nostri sistemi di controllo e di dosaggio sono progettati per offrire un’ampia gamma di soluzioni
per ogni settore di applicazione.

[Cerca tra i nostri prodotti][118]
[PISCINE][PISCINE]

###### PISCINE

Per qualsiasi tipo di esigenza, la grande esperienza di EMEC nel settore delle piscine offre la
soluzione più completa per garantire un impianto sicuro ed efficiente.
[INDUSTRIA PETROLIFERA][INDUSTRIA PETROLIFERA]

###### INDUSTRIA PETROLIFERA

Nelle raffinerie e negli impianti petroliferi i prodotti EMEC sono sinonimo di affidabilità e
precisione, oltre che di conformità alle normative.
[INDUSTRIA ALIMENTARE][INDUSTRIA ALIMENTARE]

###### INDUSTRIA ALIMENTARE

In un settore che esige qualità e sicurezza come quello alimentare, i prodotti EMEC sono in grado di
offrire anche la massima affidabilità.
[ACQUARI & ZOO][ACQUARI & ZOO]

###### ACQUARI & ZOO

Le soluzioni EMEC per acquari e zoo rispondono a ogni tipo di esigenza per garantire la salute degli
animali e dei loro ambienti.
[SPA][SPA]

###### SPA

In un settore in crescita come quello dei centri benessere e delle stazioni termali, i prodotti EMEC
rispondono a esigenze sempre più diversificate.
[POTABILIZZAZIONE][POTABILIZZAZIONE]

###### POTABILIZZAZIONE

La lunga esperienza di EMEC nella potabilizzazione dell’acqua garantisce alta qualità, alti standard
di sicurezza e la migliore efficienza.
[TORRI EVAPORATIVE][TORRI EVAPORATIVE]

###### TORRI EVAPORATIVE

Nel campo delle torri di evaporazione, i sistemi EMEC hanno alle spalle una lunga esperienza
progettuale adattandosi ai molti ambiti di applicazione possibili.
[CARWASH][CARWASH]

###### CARWASH

Nel settore dell’autolavaggio la competenza di EMEC garantisce affidabilità, robustezza e
ottimizzazione di fronte alle diverse esigenze di applicazione.
[PREVENZIONE DELLA LEGIONELLOSI][PREVENZIONE DELLA LEGIONELLOSI]

###### PREVENZIONE DELLA LEGIONELLOSI

La risposta di EMEC alla sfida della legionella è la più sofisticata ed efficace possibile,
risolvendo il problema alla radice per il massimo grado di sicurezza.
[INDUSTRIA CHIMICA][INDUSTRIA CHIMICA]

###### INDUSTRIA CHIMICA

Nel trattamento di sostanze chimiche aggressive, i prodotti EMEC offrono soluzioni sicure,
collaudate e, soprattutto, adatte alle esigenze dei clienti.
[INDUSTRIA DELLE BEVANDE][INDUSTRIA DELLE BEVANDE]

###### INDUSTRIA DELLE BEVANDE

Efficienza e sicurezza per garantire prodotti eccellenti: l’utilizzo dei sistemi EMEC nel settore
delle bevande offre il massimo rispetto degli standard igienici.
[HOTEL & RESORT][HOTEL & RESORT]

###### HOTEL & RESORT

### **Collegati ai tuoi sistemi EMEC
### da remoto con la nuova app myEmec**

Ovunque tua sia, potrai accedere direttamente dal tuo telefono a tutti i tuoi impianti in un’unica
app, in modo rapido e smart.

**Funzioni:**
*  Notifiche in tempo reale su status, allarmi e allerte
* Visualizza tutti i dati e modifica le impostazioni e le modalità di lavoro
* Registra nuovi controller e pompe sul tuo account
* Gestione multiutente semplice e veloce
* Accesso rapido alla documentazione tecnica
* Video tutorial su tutte le principali funzioni

### Le migliori soluzioni per il tuo settore

I nostri sistemi di controllo e di dosaggio sono progettati per offrire un’ampia gamma di soluzioni
per ogni settore di applicazione.

[Cerca tra i nostri prodotti][118]
[PISCINE][PISCINE]

###### PISCINE

Per qualsiasi tipo di esigenza, la grande esperienza di EMEC nel settore delle piscine offre la
soluzione più completa per garantire un impianto sicuro ed efficiente.
[INDUSTRIA PETROLIFERA][INDUSTRIA PETROLIFERA]

###### INDUSTRIA PETROLIFERA

Nelle raffinerie e negli impianti petroliferi i prodotti EMEC sono sinonimo di affidabilità e
precisione, oltre che di conformità alle normative.
[INDUSTRIA ALIMENTARE][INDUSTRIA ALIMENTARE]

###### INDUSTRIA ALIMENTARE

In un settore che esige qualità e sicurezza come quello alimentare, i prodotti EMEC sono in grado di
offrire anche la massima affidabilità.
[ACQUARI & ZOO][ACQUARI & ZOO]

###### ACQUARI & ZOO

Le soluzioni EMEC per acquari e zoo rispondono a ogni tipo di esigenza per garantire la salute degli
animali e dei loro ambienti.
[SPA][SPA]

###### SPA

In un settore in crescita come quello dei centri benessere e delle stazioni termali, i prodotti EMEC
rispondono a esigenze sempre più diversificate.
[POTABILIZZAZIONE][POTABILIZZAZIONE]

###### POTABILIZZAZIONE

La lunga esperienza di EMEC nella potabilizzazione dell’acqua garantisce alta qualità, alti standard
di sicurezza e la migliore efficienza.
[TORRI EVAPORATIVE][TORRI EVAPORATIVE]

###### TORRI EVAPORATIVE

Nel campo delle torri di evaporazione, i sistemi EMEC hanno alle spalle una lunga esperienza
progettuale adattandosi ai molti ambiti di applicazione possibili.
[CARWASH][CARWASH]

###### CARWASH

Nel settore dell’autolavaggio la competenza di EMEC garantisce affidabilità, robustezza e
ottimizzazione di fronte alle diverse esigenze di applicazione.
[PREVENZIONE DELLA LEGIONELLOSI][PREVENZIONE DELLA LEGIONELLOSI]

###### PREVENZIONE DELLA LEGIONELLOSI

La risposta di EMEC alla sfida della legionella è la più sofisticata ed efficace possibile,
risolvendo il problema alla radice per il massimo grado di sicurezza.
[INDUSTRIA CHIMICA][INDUSTRIA CHIMICA]

###### INDUSTRIA CHIMICA

Nel trattamento di sostanze chimiche aggressive, i prodotti EMEC offrono soluzioni sicure,
collaudate e, soprattutto, adatte alle esigenze dei clienti.
[INDUSTRIA DELLE BEVANDE][INDUSTRIA DELLE BEVANDE]

###### INDUSTRIA DELLE BEVANDE

Efficienza e sicurezza per garantire prodotti eccellenti: l’utilizzo dei sistemi EMEC nel settore
delle bevande offre il massimo rispetto degli standard igienici.
[HOTEL & RESORT][HOTEL & RESORT]

###### Welcome to filtaer

# Reliable water filters for endoscope washers

Welcome to FiltAER: your solution to endoscopy water contamination and internal filter clogging. As
a premier company, we specialize in providing advanced endoscopy water filters that ensure pristine
water quality, safeguarding both patients and medical equipment. With our innovative filtration
technology, FiltAER strives for smooth procedures and reliable performance, addressing the critical
challenges posed by contaminated water and internal filter issues during endoscopic surgeries.

[Globally available][2]
[Endoscopy_Waterfilter_reference]
[Franciscus Gasthuis en Vlietland_Endoscopie_waterfilter]
[Papapostolou Greece_FiltAER_Endoscopy]

##### About Us

# Join the revolution

Welcome to FiltAER, a leading and innovative endoscopy water filter company revolutionizing medical
procedures worldwide. With over 7 years of experience serving hospitals and clinics in Europe, USA,
and Australia, our cutting-edge filtration systems ensure unmatched water purity during endoscopic
surgeries. Designed for universal compatibility, FiltAER’s filters can be seamlessly integrated with
any brand of endoscope washer, providing reliable performance and meeting local legislation and AER
manufacturers’ instructions. Trust FiltAER to deliver the highest standards of safety and efficiency
in endoscopy procedures, setting new benchmarks in the healthcare industry.

[LET’S GET IN TOUCH][3]

##### Services

# Services We Offer

### ROI calculator

Read more

### Modular solutions

Capacities increase over time, so we’ve designed a modular solution

Read more

### 24/7 service

We are available at any time for any request

Read more

##### Our Products

# Single UFM elements

When it comes to endoscopy water filtration, choosing 1 UFM for each machine proves to be the
optimal choice. By dedicating a single UFM to one machine, you significantly reduce the risk of
contamination and ensure the highest level of water purity during endoscopic procedures. Trust
FiltAER’s 1 UFM per machine approach for unparalleled safety and efficiency, elevating your medical
facility’s standards to the next level.

[Read more][4]
[FiltAER - Reliable water filter endoscope washer - plug and play]

##### Our Products

# Modular UFM skids

Unlock cost savings and enhance capacity with FiltAER’s modular quantities of UFM’s for multiple
machines. Our innovative approach allows you to customize the filtration setup, reducing expenses
while meeting higher endoscopy water demands. Experience seamless scalability, improved efficiency,
and top-tier performance as you optimize resources and elevate your medical facility’s capabilities
with FiltAER’s modular UFM solutions.

[Read more][5]

maintenance contract we have concluded, our filters are tested for integrity, cleaned and
disinfected twice a year. We look back with great pleasure on the collaboration with FiltAER and

## How will InterFishMarket provide funding for your transactions?

Our Marketplace acts as a central counterpart in all transactions so we can immediately pay your
sales and further defer your purchases using different financing solutions available through IFM and
thus eliminating the risk of insolvency for your company.

## Who is it for?

Are you a seafood industry professional working in any of the following categories?

#### [Producers/Farmers][14]

#### [Wholesalers/Distributors][15]

#### [Retailers/Supermarket Operators][16]

#### [Processors/Industry][17]

## [Start using InterFishMarket now!][18]

## IFM is backed by a team of professionals from the seafood & finance sectors with a combined
## experience of over 100 years

InterFishMarket was created by professionals, for professionals. Professionals just like you who
interact daily with the needs, issues and deliverables of the seafood industry.

[FIND OUT MORE][19]

## Trading system & Marketplace

### InterFishMarket is a **neutral marketplace** and acts as an intermediary to all transactions and
### **does not take risk positions; the system works like the most established e-commerce
### platforms.**
### 
### Our goal is to facilitate exchange activities in a transparent and efficient way between buyers
### and sellers all over the world, while offering both parties **access to financial services like
### insurance and financing.**
### 
### It is possible to execute transactions in two ways:

## Online Trading – Live Market
* Enter your sales or purchase order.
* Receive offers and close transactions on the platform.
* Enjoy the insurance and financial benefits that IFM offers you.

## Offline Trading – OTC Trade
* Close your offline sales (as you do every day on the phone, e-mail or Skype).
* Register your Trade on the IFM platform.
* Enjoy the insurance and financial benefits that IFM offers you.

## Benefits

#### [Smart Contract][20]

Sign legally binding sale and purchase agreements directly on the Marketplace.

#### [Certified Documents][21]

Always have the certainty of sending and receiving sales documents such as invoice, packing list or
signed CMR.

#### [Save Time][22]

Expiring invoices warnings and automated payment reminders, do not waste your time to track
payments, we'll take care of everything!


#### [Insurance Claims][23]

Do you have trouble with a payment?
No problem, no legal fulfillment, no document required: you just have to click, we do the job.

#### [Min. Insurance Cost][24]

IFM manages the insurance policy and our Marketplace doesn’t require any data for insurance
purposes. You pay only if you use the service, not on an expected result.

#### [Service Flexibility][25]

You can change the financial product requested at any time or even cancel it.

## Testimonials

I use IFM platform for my trades, it’s easy to use and full of useful too

tremendous savings available by purchasing used medical equipment instead of new..

# About Us

#### Our Health Mission

Our mission is to provide high quality endoscopic and surgical services to the residents of the
Sunshine Coast catering for the needs of private patients both insured and uninsured according to
their needs.

Noosa Surgical & Endoscopy was founded in 1999 and is a National Standard  Licensed Private Health
Facility. Equipment used is comprehensive, modern and state-of the art maintained and regularly
serviced by Bio-Engineers.

[Find out more][25]

#### People Who Care

Dr John Lancaster is Director and Principal Provider of surgical and endoscopic services.

Ms Katrina Ward is our Nursing Director. 

We are supported by a team of highly skilled and experienced specialist anaesthetists and registered
nursing staff.

### Our Partners

## Site Content

#### Our services - Noosa Surgical & Endoscopy

Colonoscopy

Gastroscopy

Flexible sigmoidoscopy

Banding of haemorrhoids

Skin excisions and flaps

#### Our Endoscopic Services - Noosa Private Hospital

Colonoscopy

Gastroscopy

Flexible sigmoidoscopy

Interventional Endoscopy - stents, dilatations, resection adenomas

Treatment of haemorrhoids and anal fissures



#### About Dr Lancaster

Born in Bristol UK and moved to Australia in 1989

Graduate Bristol University

Fellowship Royal College Surgeons England 1986

Fellowship Royal Australian College Surgeons 1992

Member Gastroenterology Society Australia (GESA)

Re-Certification in Colonoscopy 2016, 2019, 2023

Visiting Specialist Noosa Private Hospital

Clinical Examiner and Senior Instructor Royal Australasian College of Surgeons

Living in Noosa since 1994

#### Noosa Surgical & Endoscopy - equipment

PENTAX Medical 90i series scopes

Pentax Discovery AI polyp detection system

Soluscope *SPRINT *automated scope re-processor

Wassenberg 300D Drying Cabinet

Medivator EndoStratus CO2 insufflation and irrigation systems

#### FAQs

***Do you do Gap Cover ?***

Yes ! - No gap charges are made by Dr Lancaster for treatment of insured patients in Noosa Private
Hospital for operation or endoscopy. In Noosa Surgical & Endoscopy Centre medical charges are
bulk-billed but** there is a facility charge to cover treatment costs which is currently $680 ($580
pensioner rate) for a single procedure or $880 ($780) for gastroscopy and colonoscopy***** if
medically indicated.***

***Combined gastroscopy and colonoscopy done at the same time ican be problematic for ambulatory
patients and presents a logistic burden on a day surgery - we reserve the right not to perform both
procedures at the same appointment if not clinically justified.***





***Do I need a consultation before the procedure?***

For most endoscopic examinations a consultation prior to the procedure is not required
(open-access). The referral letter and a health questionnaire is carefully scrutinised - if all
seems satisfactory admission arrangements can be made - if there are potential problems identified a
telephone or face-to-face consultation may be required.  Proposed surgical operations invariably
require a pre-operative consult to assess the benefits of the proposed procedure. Sadly, Qld Health
have withdrawn the facility of being able to directly list public patients for surgery locally at
Noosa Hospital.



***Do I need a referral?***

All procedure or consultations require a referral from your Family Doctor or occasionally from a
referring Specialist.



***What's the difference between the different endoscope examinations***

An **endoscopy **is the term commonly used for examining the stomach. More precisely it is termed
oesophago-gastro-duodenoscopy (OGD) or panendoscopy but it is more convenient to refer to it as
gastroscopy. 

A **colonoscopy **is a full examination of the whole length of the large bowel including the rectum
and may incorporate a peek into the terminal ileum. This requires a significant bowel cleansing
regimen.

**Flexible sigmoidoscopy** uses a colonoscope but only examines the distal 1/3 of the colon (usually
to the splenic flexure) - it doesn't require such an arduous bowel preparation as colonoscopy,
usually just a suppository 2 hours before.

**Rigid sigmoidoscopy** is a examination principally of the rectum using a short plastic tube and
light. It can be done during a consultation but s best prepared for with a suppository - it does not
give such good views as a flexible sigmoidoscopy but is cheaper and quicker to organise.

#### UPDATE Feb 26

- As of February 2026, after over40 years as a surgeon,  I have decided the time has come to hang up
my scalpel and leave operating to  the youngsters - I do, however, look forward to continuing to

Show More

- As of February 2026, after over40 years as a surgeon,  I have decided the time has come to hang up
my scalpel and leave operating to  the youngsters - I do, however, look forward to continuing to
 provide endoscopic services to the community for a few more years :) 


-Fleet and phosho-soda bowel preps are no longer available in Australia but there are plenty of
alternatives we can recommend!



**- Those with recent onset cough, sore throat, runny nose or fever are requested NOT to attend the
surgery but to ring or email and ask for advice**



**- For more information from Qld Health click **[**here**][26]



**Equipment**



We have purchased the first Pentax Discovery AI system in Australia, to detect polyps and are one of
a handful of endoscopy units in Qld to utilise this.



**Recertification**



We are certified under National Standards. Our colonoscopists are certified with GESA as per
National Standards and our anaesthtists are all highly experienced specialists.





**Infection Control**



Recent  water sampling revealed no evidence of legionella sp. We have had no documented instances of
cross infection. We institute regular performance checks of our scope processing equipment in
accordance with Australian Standards



**Patient   safety**



There have been no Sentinel Events during our patient care in the last year.



**Medicare changes:**



With effect from November 2019 Medicare introduced strict requirements for qualifying for a rebate
for colonoscopy, together with time intervals between examinations - this has proved a challenge for
doctors and patients alike to get to grips with and unfortunately means colonoscopy is no longer
available 'on demand' - for further details Google" MBS colonoscopy item numbers" or click [here
 ][27]

Yes ! - No gap charges are made by Dr Lancaster for treatment of insured patients in Noosa Private
Hospital for operation or endoscopy. In Noosa Surgical & Endoscopy Centre medical charges are
bulk-billed but** there is a facility charge to cover treatment costs which is currently $680 ($580
pensioner rate) for a single procedure or $880 ($780) for gastroscopy and colonoscopy***** if
medically indicated.***

***Combined gastroscopy and colonoscopy done at the same time ican be problematic for ambulatory
patients and presents a logistic burden on a day surgery - we reserve the right not to perform both
procedures at the same appointment if not clinically justified.***





***Do I need a consultation before the procedure?***

For most endoscopic examinations a consultation prior to the procedure is not required
(open-access). The referral letter and a health questionnaire is carefully scrutinised - if all
seems satisfactory admission arrangements can be made - if there are potential problems identified a
telephone or face-to-face consultation may be required.  Proposed surgical operations invariably
require a pre-operative consult to assess the benefits of the proposed procedure. Sadly, Qld Health
have withdrawn the facility of being able to directly list public patients for surgery locally at
Noosa Hospital.



***Do I need a referral?***

All procedure or consultations require a referral from your Family Doctor or occasionally from a
referring Specialist.



***What's the difference between the different endoscope examinations***

An **endoscopy **is the term commonly used for examining the stomach. More precisely it is termed
oesophago-gastro-duodenoscopy (OGD) or panendoscopy but it is more convenient to refer to it as
gastroscopy. 

A **colonoscopy **is a full examination of the whole length of the large bowel including the rectum
and may incorporate a peek into the terminal ileum. This requires a significant bowel cleansing
regimen.

**Flexible sigmoidoscopy** uses a colonoscope but only examines the distal 1/3 of the colon (usually
to the splenic flexure) - it doesn't require such an arduous bowel preparation as colonoscopy,
usually just a suppository 2 hours before.

**Rigid sigmoidoscopy** is a examination principally of the rectum using a short plastic tube and
light. It can be done during a consultation but s best prepared for with a suppository - it does not
give such good views as a flexible sigmoidoscopy but is cheaper and quicker to organise.

industrial-grade displays tailored for smart manufacturing environments. Why Rugged Displays Matter

human-machine interfaces (HMIs), machine status panels, and embedded control displays. These systems
operate in harsh and variable conditions, including: Wide temperature extremes High humidity or
dusty environments Continuous operation (24/7) Mechanical vibration or shock In such settings,
standard consumer-grade monitors may fail or degrade rapidly. Industrial-grade displays from a
trusted manufacturer are essential to ensure reliable visualization, system integrity, and minimal
downtime. Oscy Monitor: Proven Expertise as OEM/ODM Manufacturer As a seasoned manufacturer with
over 14 years’ experience in LCD and touch-screen technologies, Oscy Monitor offers both
mass-production and tailor-made solutions through its OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and ODM
(Original Design Manufacturer) services. Some of their key competitive strengths include:
Customization capabilities: Oscy supports high/low-temperature adaptations, specialized interface

#  A Cleaning Technology Like No Other

### Why risk it?

Don’t end up in the news for something that can easily be avoided.

Learn how PARAMETRIK is different from the rest.

We follow IFUs no mater how complex

> “…improvements are necessary and we are committed to taking additional steps to reduce infections
> and contamination even further.”

— Jeff Shuren, Director of the F.D.A.’s Center for Devices and Radiological Health
[ Read More ][22]

Manual cleaning and disinfection methods for flexible endoscopes have not changed in **decades**.
Not only is it risky, it’s a drain on your resources.

#  A Cleaning Technology Like No Other

### Why risk it?

Don’t end up in the news for something that can easily be avoided.

Learn how PARAMETRIK is different from the rest.

# Poor Manual Cleaning Puts Your Patients At Risk…

We follow IFUs no mater how complex

> “…improvements are necessary and we are committed to taking additional steps to reduce infections
> and contamination even further.”

— Jeff Shuren, Director of the F.D.A.’s Center for Devices and Radiological Health
[ Read More ][22]
 
 
 

## The Current Problems

Manual cleaning and disinfection methods for flexible endoscopes have not changed in **decades**.
Not only is it risky, it’s a drain on your resources.

[Liabilities for Your Organization.png]

**Liabilities for your organization**

[Higher Risk for Infection.png]

**Higher risk for infection**

[Staff Traning and Process Management.png]

**Staff training and process management**

[Smarter and Stronger Bugs.png]

**Smarter and stronger bugs**

# PARAMETRIK *reduces* risk

PARAMETRIK’s revolutionary process delivers a superior cleaning result

a properly cleaned endoscope paves the way for terminal sterilization.

# **The MACH I Instrument Processor**

[MACH I Beauty Shot 1.png]
 

## Not your typical AER…
* Studies demonstrate protein removal to < 1.2 µg/cm²
* 510(k) 101158 indicates manual cleaning is not required for validated endoscopes
* **No Capital needed**
* Reduce operational costs by 50% or more

[ Learn more ][23]
 

 

#  What PARAMETRIK Can Do For You

[Off-Site Reprocessing_24 Hour Turnaround.png]

### Off-Site Reprocessing

Your endoscopes are transported to our specialized facilities and multi-point inspected, IFU cleaned
and undergo EO sterilization in the Andersen EOGas4.

And your scope is returned **within 24 hours.**

[ Learn More ][24]
[Parametrik Swoop 2.png]

[PURE FUNCTIONALITY & SPACE SAVING]

##### PURE FUNCTIONALITY & SPACE SAVING

They include multiple models of steel racks with various structures and functional solutions. They
guarantee durability and storage safety. Thanks to the availability of a wide range of sizes and
visual versions, our products can be individually adapted to the available spaces, as well as the
needs and preferences of users. The ergonomics of the storage systems ensure efficient use of space
and maximise the storage capacity.
[EFFICIENCY MEETING DIFFERENT NEEDS]

##### EFFICIENCY MEETING DIFFERENT NEEDS

QBL dryers are considered by most of their users as the most efficient devices of this type
available on the market. Their efficiency is mainly due to carefully selected highquality heating
omponents, the system of openable nozzles and a well-thought-out design – which all ensure intensive
airflow. Our dryers are energy efficient thanks to the extensive parameterisation of modes and
operating times. In the main models it is possible to pre-set times for each day of the week
independently.
[CREATING ADVANCED SKIER ZONES]

##### CREATING ADVANCED SKIER ZONES

Lockers are the main equipment of ski depot facilities. It is the storage ergonomics, the drying
efficiency, the intuitive locking systems, the durability of the construction and the stylish design
that determine the quality of ski depots around the world. This is what makes both the customers and
the users satisfied. Ski lockers made by QBL, apart from durability and functionality, are
distinguished by a wide range of possibilities to customize the equipment and door finishing.
[CUSTOMIZATION & NATURAL DESIGN]

##### CUSTOMIZATION & NATURAL DESIGN

Made of high-quality furniture boards, utility components and steel structural elements, our service
desks, checkin desks, benches and modular sofas are all modern and consistent in their look. The
ability to fit into storage systems and a number of well-thought-out functions improve the
efficiency of service and comfort of use.
[SMART EQUIPMENT FOR AN ATTRACTIVE EXPOSITION]

##### SMART EQUIPMENT FOR AN ATTRACTIVE EXPOSITION

Our line of display products is designed for sports shops offering professional skiing and
snowboarding equipment, clothing, footwear, outdoor gear and various types of accessories. The
systems consist of modular elements adjustable to the sales space, to its shape and style.
[Service Equipment]

##### Service Equipment

Client Testimonial

### Jimmy’s Story

For over 50 years, Jimmy traveled the world producing shows for music legends. During his time on
the road, he was exposed to asbestos while handling studio equipment.

After being diagnosed with mesothelioma decades later, Jimmy reached out to our firm for help. We
were able to secure the compensation he deserved.

“One check showed up, and then another check showed up, and then another, and they’re still coming
in now,” expressed Jimmy. “I know my wife will be taken care of for the rest of her life after I’m
gone.”
